cell_policy: Use a verified cell or supercell with an even number of Zn4O units, 3 linkers per Zn4O unit, and integer equal linker counts. Derive slots from that cell; do not force the synthetic 12-slot graph onto it.
minimum_stoichiometric_inventory: Zn8O2(BDC)3(NH2_BDC)3; composition bookkeeping only, not a supplied crystallographic unit cell
orientation_policy: Declare a deterministic initial orientation for every asymmetric amino linker; include orientation states explicitly in a later expanded search.
initial_spin_charge_policy: Neutral framework with nominal Zn(II) d10 nodes; verify the atomistic calculation setup. This is not a strong-correlation or quantum-advantage benchmark.
target_ratio_status: Chosen computational test composition, not a claim of experimental incorporation at 50:50
missing_inputs: validated node and linker geometries with attachment-site mapping
actual periodic energies with recorded computational settings
construction_backend: PORMAKE or an existing deterministic builder; validate topology and local bonding after construction
scope: Later test of construction, linker assignment, relaxation, validity checks and energy-model fitting for one physical topology
